title: Taskmaster Lugald Brokenskull
summary: Defeat the taskmaster's supporting force to reveal his attackable form.
overview: Defeat the taskmaster's supporting force to reveal his attackable form.

roles.label: Everyone

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The controller counts qualifying death signals.
The twenty-third signal removes the protected Taskmaster Luga and spawns Taskmaster Lugald Brokenskull.
The controller then depops, making this a single transition per spawn cycle.

notes: Approval E378. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The exact set of enemies supplying the twenty-three signals should be checked against the deployed spawn population before publication.
